core1b.fresh_task: A student holds tracing paper behind an opaque plane mirror and sees no sharp image, but a camera in front photographs the reflection. Explain both observations with ray directions.
core1b.protected_work: Distinguish image formation from ray interception and secondary imaging.

stages.attempt: A student holds tracing paper behind an opaque plane mirror and sees no sharp image, but a camera in front photographs the reflection. Explain both observations with ray directions.
stages.reconstruct: Reflected rays stay in front and diverge as if from the virtual image. The paper behind receives no converging reflected rays; the camera lens intercepts them and forms a real sensor image.
stages.diagnose: Only if your saved answer demonstrates this error: Virtual images cannot be observed or photographed. Otherwise record insufficient evidence; compare your actual reasoning with the reconstruction.
stages.repair: Separate virtual object-space ray extensions from real image formation inside the eye/camera.
stages.boundary_test: What if the finite mirror blocks all rays to one observer?
